plain_english_policy: This bill does not change laws, budgets, or infrastructure operations. It is a ceremonial resolution that officially renames a specific stretch of US Highway 72 in Alabama to honor First Lieutenant Frankie Lee Wallace.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no operational policy shift; it would only establish an official name for the highway segment and authorize placing commemorative signs. The bill directs state officials (via resolution) to provide copies of the text to family members and local legislators, but does not mandate funding or construction.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsor (Representative Morrow) supports honoring First Lieutenant Frankie Lee Wallace by naming the highway after him. The text does not indicate support for any other policy positions.
evidence_quotes: "NAMING A PORTION OF US HIGHWAY 72 AT MILE MARKER 18 TO THE ALABAMA/MISSISSIPPI STATE LINE THE FRANKIE LEE WALLACE HIGHWAY."

"That we hereby designate the section of US Highway 72 beginning at Mile Marker 18 and continuing West to the Alabama/Mississippi State Line as the 'Frankie Lee Wallace Highway' in honor and memory of First Lieutenant Frankie Lee Wallace."
